name: Synthetic test fixture -- NOT a real standard

source.verification_note: Synthetic fixture invented for src/compliance.py's own unit tests. Not derived from any real standard; values are round numbers chosen for testable arithmetic, not deemed-to-satisfy limits.

A1.description: Fixture class with every rule present -- exercises the full PASS/FAIL path.
A1.notes: min_air_pct is null on purpose: exercises the 'rule does not apply' path, distinct from an absent key.

A2.description: Fixture class with only max_w_b present -- every other rule key is absent, so the engine must report UNKNOWN with a reason for each, not guess a value.
A2.notes: min_cement_kg_m3, min_strength_MPa, min_air_pct, max_scm_fraction are all deliberately absent (not null).

A3.description: Fixture class with a numeric min_air_pct -- exercises the UNKNOWN-without-air_pct and PASS/FAIL-with-air_pct paths.
A3.notes: All other rules null on purpose so only the air rule is under test.
